# Bevy

> Bevy is an enterprise community platform that combines event management, forums, AI-powered engagement tools, and analytics to help organizations build and scale thriving communities.

Bevy provides an all-in-one solution for community builders, combining features like virtual and in-person event management, branded forums with AI moderation, gamification, and real-time analytics. The platform integrates with leading CRM systems like Salesforce and HubSpot, and is trusted by enterprise customers including UiPath, Twitch, and Slack.

## Core Platform

- [Bevy: Your Community's Growth Partner](https://bevy.com/b): All-in-one community platform with CRM integration and data-driven analytics for enterprise community growth
- [Events and Groups](https://bevy.com/b/events-and-groups): Scalable event and group management tools for chapters and communities
- [Community Forums](https://bevy.com/b/forums): Branded community forums with AI moderation and real-time analytics
- [Pricing](https://bevy.com/b/pricing): Enterprise pricing plans with customizable features and CRM integrations

## AI & Engagement Features

- [Engagement Agent](https://bevy.com/b/engagement-agent): AI-powered Engagement Agent for automating community workflows and retention
- [Community Knowledge Agent](https://bevy.com/b/community-knowledge-agent): AI-powered Community Knowledge Agent for instant content access and member support
- [Gamification](https://bevy.com/b/gamification): Gamification system with points, badges, and leaderboards for engagement

## Events & Meetups

- [Empowering Community-Led Meetups](https://bevy.com/b/events): Platform for organizing in-person and virtual community meetups and events
